title: NR Corporate Typefaces
safeHtml:
Nazca Railway Corporate Typefaces, are the Chinese and Latin typefaces independently develop by NR.

Introduction

Nazca Railway has 4 self-made typefaces, 2 Songs, 1 Gothic, and 1 Small Seal. As the official name of the typefaces have never been revealed, this article will use "NR Song No. 1" and "NR Song No. 2" to classify. "NR Song No. 1" has been suspended and replaced by "NR Song No. 2" completely.

NR Song No. 1

"NR Song No. 1" used "DFLiSong-Md" as the base of its style, but be drawn under traditional glyph form, and changed its "hook" to a sharper one. This typefaces was abandoned now. Collected 1000+ Chinese glyph characters. It had been started using once the set may afford general graphic requirement in NR. This typeface also support Simplified and Variant Chinese characters, but also be drawn under traditional glyph form.

NR Song No. 2

Background

As NR had received mixed reviews regarding "NR Song No. 1", NR decided to suspended the typeface in early 2017, and started studying the feasibility of making a new typeface. Before, "NR Song No. 2" was born, NR changed all the typeface on signage to "DFLiSong-Md". After months of research, NR decided to make a new typeface as its corporate and signage typeface.

Characteristics

"NR Song No. 2" is based on the style of the "MTR Sung No. 2" (similar to "remake"). Although both of them have a similar style, NR's takes a more smooth and natural strokes than MTR's. Also, the strokes of this font are more square and thicker than "NR Song No. 1", and the weight and style of the characters have been improved, which is more clearly visible in the signage boards. Same as "NR Song No. 1", this font is also being drawn under traditional glyph form. Currently "NR Song No. 2" collects more than 7900 glyphs, including all stations and lines names of different divisions.

At the beginning, there were still some concourse and directional signage boards using "DFLiSong-Md", but now all boards in the system have changed to this font.

NR Crystal Typeface

This typeface is an experimental typeface created between two generations of "NR Songs", which has a style between serif and sans-serif. It had been applied on some covers of station reports, but was then ended due to the progresses of "NR Song No.2". The production was later restarted in January 2022. Currently collects 241 glyphs.

NR Small Seal

NR's small seal typeface is a typeface dedicated to the experiment of "station banners" in Los Sengas Division. Currently collects 195 glyphs.

English Typeface

English typeface of Nazca Railway was based on "Myriad" and "Transport", and is the attached English typeface of "NR Song No.1". It was completed in mid 2016 and started using widely. However, it was then abandoned as NR changed its official Chinese typeface to "NR Song No.2" and used "Myriad" as its official English typeface.

Currently these typefaces have been widely applied on different signage boards and productions of Los Sengas Division. However, all related font files and official names are classified as confidential of of the Nazca Railway.

Fun Facts

  • NR Song is mostly seen on in-station signage. DFLiSong-Md is used instead in digital files.
  • Although Peckern Metro is under NR, its in-station signage use DFLiSong-Md instead of the NR Song.
